description: Does this remote MCP server work, and is it worth connecting or paying for? Sends initialize and tools/list only (never calls a tool) and reports reachability, protocol version, sign-in method (OAuth protected-resource metadata), x402 payment terms if it asks for payment, latency, tool count and token cost, provider compatibility, poisoning patterns in tools and server instructions, issues and a grade A-F, plus a pin for later diffs. https public hosts only. Free: 10 checks/day per IP, then $0.005 via x402 or credits.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.
